text:
Ely Office

Offline-first desktop apps in Rust and GPUI. Files stay in your folders; no account, no cloud service.

Download from office.elygpui.com or the latest release: Windows, macOS (Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux (AppImage, deb, rpm, Arch, Nix; Debian 11 and Ubuntu 20.04 or newer). Each platform has one installer with every app, and an update replaces them all.

 App Does Engine 
 --- --- --- 
 ElyDoc Word processing (DOCX, ODT) LibreOfficeKit 
 ElyTable Spreadsheets (XLSX, ODS, CSV) LibreOfficeKit 
 ElyShow Presentations (PPTX, ODP) LibreOfficeKit, system media 
 ElyPDF PDF reading and editing, OCR, signatures MuPDF, Tesseract 
 ElyMail Mail over IMAP, POP3 and SMTP; follows the system proxy own IMAP and POP3, mail-send, SQLite 
 ElyTree Git client Git 
 ElyMark Markdown pulldown-cmark, RaTeX, mermaid-rs-renderer; MuPDF for PDF export 
 ElyAgent Second release Kigi CLI 

ElyMail signs in to Microsoft with OAuth, to Gmail and iCloud with an app password, and to QQ Mail, 163 and 126 with an authorization code.

 Build

Install Rust with rustup ( rust-toolchain.toml pins the version), then the system packages. Every system also needs Git, Python 3, curl, Node.js 22.18 or newer (the first to run the site's TypeScript tests unflagged) and pnpm ( check.sh and the site use the last two).

- macOS: Xcode (gpui compiles its shaders when the app starts, so the separate Metal toolchain is not needed); then brew install cmake ninja pkg-config make gnu-sed bison flex gettext autoconf automake node pnpm bash for LibreOffice and the checks ( build-libreoffice.sh puts Homebrew's GNU make, sed, bison, flex and gettext first; the scripts need bash 5, since macOS's own bash 3.2 exits 0 after a set -u abort). The Intel release runs under Rosetta with an x86 64 bash 5 that scripts/build-bash.sh builds into /ely-share/bash-x86 64 .
- Windows: Visual Studio 2022 with the C++ workload (MSVC, a Windows SDK and CMake with Ninja) and clang-cl, from its "C++ Clang tools" component or LLVM in C:\Program Files\LLVM (LibreOffice builds Skia with it); gpui compiles its shaders with the SDK's fxc.exe . Git for Windows supplies bash and curl. LibreOffice builds under Cygwin in C:\cygwin64 ( ELY CYGWIN elsewhere) with autoconf, automake and LibreOffice's GNU make in /opt/lo/bin , as its Windows build guide sets up.
- Linux, one line per family, then pnpm. LibreOffice builds inside packaging/linux/container.sh , hence Docker. Ubuntu's own Node.js is too old, so Node.js 22 comes from NodeSource:

 

 scripts/doctor.sh checks each of these for the system it runs on.

 

ElyMail needs a Microsoft client ID at build time: put ELY MICROSOFT CLIENT ID= in cred.txt at the repository root (git ignores it).

The scripts run on macOS, on Windows (LibreOffice under Cygwin, MuPDF with MSBuild) and on Linux inside packaging/linux/container.sh , an AlmaLinux 8 image that keeps the binaries on glibc 2.28.

 Experimental R macros

ElyTable can run local R macros on a selected range, including values, header
formatting and column widths. See docs/r-macros.md for
setup, the small API and its limits. Requires R (Rscript) and a LOK engine
built with patch 0081.

 Release

Pushing a v tag runs .github/workflows/release.yml , four jobs that wait for no other, all on our own machines. Each job first checks the gates and builds nothing if one fails: the release notes state how many fixes were not reviewed again and why a release comes less than seven days after the last ( scripts/release-gate.py ); docs/perf/ holds this version's benchmark for the system and its first opens after install and after reboot, with a reason for each case over 30% slower ( tests/perf/baseline.py ); pr.yml passed on the tagged commit; the host's cargo, and the container's on Linux, is huacnlee/cargo. Self-hosted runners build macOS (arm64, and Intel under Rosetta), Windows and Linux x86 64 (in the AlmaLinux 8 container on an Omarchy host) with scripts/ci.sh ; there is no Linux arm64 release. Each job uploads its packages and update manifests; x86 64 Linux alone uploads the source archives. The Linux job also builds ely-office , one deb, rpm and Arch package that holds every app and one copy of the LibreOffice kernel for ElyDoc, ElyTable and ElyShow ( packaging/linux/bundle.sh ). macOS builds are signed and notarized.

 Tests

 cargo test --workspace ; the script tests in tests/scripts , listed in its README (the window tests need macOS Accessibility permission; Linux tests run in containers); the benchmarks tests/perf/bench.py and tests/perf/folder-search.rs ; the first opens of the installed apps tests/perf/firsts.py install and reboot (on Windows it records Microsoft Office's beside them, ungated); the idle engines tests/perf/idle.py (no CPU in ten minutes, memory within a tenth of tests/perf/idle.json ; part of scripts/release-tests.sh ); the load tests tests/perf/load.py (many large documents open and edited at once, the command line editing the one being typed in) and tests/perf/pdfs.py , on Linux through tests/perf/linux.sh .

 Documents

 
 --- --- 
 PRD.md Requirements 
 agents.md Stack, rules and commands; the single source of truth 
 tests/scripts/README.md Each test script: what it checks and what it needs 
 tests/fixtures/README.md Each shared test sample 
 tasks/TASKS.md Progress 
 docs/decisions.md Decision log, by date 
 docs/help.md Help: opening and saving, panels, recovery, offline limits, repositories, mail 
 patches/UPSTREAM.md The patches that fix upstream defects and could go upstream 
 docs/compatibility.md Compatibility list: each section last verified for 0.1.11; Office on the web opened 30 Ely-saved files and 18 large, odd and extreme ones at 0.1.15 
 docs/accessibility.md Accessibility and language review 
 docs/perf/ Benchmark records 
 docs/licenses.md Licences and sources 
 docs/acceptance.md Audit acceptance: each item, its task and its last review 
 CONTRIBUTING.md Opening a pull request
